svg.title: GPO Copilot Operations Dashboard - 28-day view, Sep 1-28, 2026 (fictional training data)
svg.desc: Training dashboard for slide 20. Enabled 800, active 612, never active 85, Excel adoption 19 percent, Production Operations 38 percent active rate, agent active users rising weekly. Fictional data for the US Government Publishing Office Copilot operations course.
